people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”
translations.bsb: And the LORD said to Moses, “The man must surely be put to death. The whole congregation is to stone him outside the camp.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
